faq.title: Questions shoppers ask
faq.description: Everything you need to know before your first order.

different.question: What makes LUXE different from other marketplaces?
different.answer: We combine editorial curation with a multi-vendor marketplace — every brand and product is reviewed for quality, presentation, and customer experience before going live.

shipping.question: How does shipping work?
shipping.answer: Shipping options depend on the seller and your location. Many orders qualify for complimentary delivery over {amount, number, usd}, with tracking provided as soon as your order ships.

returns.question: What is your return policy?
returns.answer: Most items can be returned within {days, number} days in original condition. Return details appear on each product and store page before you purchase.

payments.question: Are payments secure?
payments.answer: Yes. Checkout uses industry-standard encryption and trusted payment providers. We never store full card details on our servers.

sell.question: Can I sell on LUXE?
sell.answer: Absolutely. Independent brands and merchants can apply to open a storefront on our marketplace with dedicated seller tools and analytics.
